claim_text: This AI pilot is ready for production use
evidence_source: go/no-go decision record; rollback test; incident path review
scope_boundary: single workflow; named user group; specified model/version; controlled environment
adviser_questions: Security and privacy review complete? rollback owner named?
approved_wording: Do not use externally until reviewer signs approved wording
stop_or_escalate_signal: Production-ready claim without rollback, owner, incident path or model/version boundary

claim_text: The AI pilot reduced support handling time by 20%
evidence_source: sampled ticket report; baseline method; finance/ops validation
scope_boundary: sample size; date range; channel; excluded queues; no customer-wide extrapolation
approved_wording: In a controlled internal pilot sample, handling-time movement was reviewed; no public savings claim approved
stop_or_escalate_signal: Savings or productivity claim based on anecdote or unapproved sample

claim_text: The AI workflow is compliant with privacy requirements
evidence_source: privacy impact notes; data inventory; adviser response
scope_boundary: specific workflow, geography, data categories and vendors only
adviser_questions: Can any public compliance wording be used?
approved_wording: No compliance claim approved; use operational readiness wording only
stop_or_escalate_signal: Compliant/certified language without formal adviser approval

claim_text: The AI assistant is safe for customers
evidence_source: risk review; red-team examples; human override log
scope_boundary: specific customer-facing task; human approval required; excluded regulated advice
adviser_questions: Does safety wording overstate test evidence?
approved_wording: Use limited wording: human-reviewed pilot controls are being evaluated
stop_or_escalate_signal: Safe/autonomous language without failure-mode evidence and human boundary

evidence_source: evaluation dataset; test method; reviewer notes; regression run
scope_boundary: test set definition; metric formula; model version; excluded cases
adviser_questions: Does the metric match the business decision?
approved_wording: Accuracy wording pending reviewer-approved metric definition
stop_or_escalate_signal: Accuracy claim without dataset, metric formula, version or retest plan
